visual_rule: Every illustration is a conceptual cute scene with generic people and unmarked props. No logo, readable text, named real person, historical reenactment, patent drawing, real race/shop/trade-show reconstruction, or wartime reconstruction. Brand names, dates, patent numbers, percentages and citations appear only in post-produced cards.
speech: single zh-TW narrator; sources are silent metadata; no burned-in captions

outro.link_elements: Studio overlay after video assembly; no link is baked into illustration
